Caliptra-specific status

Absolute Address:
Base Offset:
0x204
Size:
0x4
Source:
usb_ocp_recovery_reg.rdl

Description

Caliptra/vendor-specific FIFO status bits outside the OCP Recovery command set, relocated from the non-spec INDIRECT_FIFO_STATUS byte-0 bits. Read-only; driven by usb_ocp_recovery_cms_fifo.sv.

Contents

Bits Identifier Access Reset Decoded Name
[31:3] RESERVED_31_3 r 0x0 Reserved
[2] IMAGE_DONE r 0x0 Image done sticky status
[1] OVERFLOW r 0x0 Overflow sticky status
[0] REGION_RESET r 0x0 Region reset sticky status

Field Descriptions

RESERVED_31_3 - Reserved

Reserved for future Caliptra-specific status bits.

IMAGE_DONE - Image done sticky status

Sticky: set when the pushed DWORD count reaches the programmed image size. Driven by usb_ocp_recovery_cms_fifo.sv image_done_q.

OVERFLOW - Overflow sticky status

Sticky: set on a genuine FIFO-full overflow drop while the image is still incomplete. Driven by usb_ocp_recovery_cms_fifo.sv overflow_q.

REGION_RESET - Region reset sticky status

Sticky: set when an INDIRECT_FIFO_CTRL region reset occurs; cleared on the next region reset. Driven by usb_ocp_recovery_cms_fifo.sv region_reset_q.
